history.summary: A freehold 3BR (1,119 sqft) at Casa Emerald (2002) near Dakota MRT in D14, asking $1.65M ($1,475 psf). Sensible price band, efficient size, freehold and a city-fringe location near Dakota — a reasonable but unremarkable hold, limited by thin data (3 txns) and boutique scale.
history.rating_rationale: $1,475 psf for a FH D14 3BR is fair-to-attractive, and $1.65M sits in the liquid family band with an efficient 1,119 sqft layout. Freehold + 620m to Dakota MRT (CCL) and the Paya Lebar Central catchment are real positives. Held back by only 3 URA txns (no reliable rate), a 2002 build, and likely boutique scale limiting liquidity. A solid hold rather than a standout — squarely Neutral.
red_flags: Only 3 URA txns — no reliable appreciation rate
No URA median PSF to benchmark the asking price
catalysts: Paya Lebar Central transformation and airbase relocation upside
Liquid price band and efficient 3BR size
